content:
Overview

Rajkot is a city in Gujarat with a population of 1,500,000. A major industrial center in Gujarat, known for its engineering and automotive industries, and as the hometown of Mahatma Gandhi. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 290 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
